caption: The drawing depicts a central large brown spherical object, likely made of wood, supported on a rounded wooden base, with turned wooden columns on three sides. The sphere has metallic components on its left and right sides. At the bottom of the sphere, extending downward, is a conical neck with light beige and white bands, secured to the base with a metallic clasp or band. There are two small, white or cream-colored numbered balls, one marked "17" and the other "2", positioned on the flat surface of the base near a green circular recess, which sits directly below the neck of the sphere. The wooden base has a circular, stepped design and all objects are set against an off-white background. The overall color palette includes shades of brown, beige, cream, green, white, and metallic gray.
title: Keno Gambling Game
